admission.justification: A future classifier must not merge two path-keyed obligations into a guessed renamed item and lose deletion/addition attribution.

applicability: The four-tree reviewer rename boundary chosen in MIK-R57@v2 appendix83/151 and rule6.
conditions: Changed-file items and lane-side projections use each concrete changed path; an added path has no before path and a deleted path no after path.
exclusions: No prohibition on Git itself detecting renames for other purposes and no claim that this projection owns the underlying Git measurement.
statement: A rename is a deletion and an addition because changed-file items are keyed by path.
